title: Zahra De Janazay Te Zainab Ro Ro Kay Vain Ay Kardi Ay
body:
Nana Teray Shaire Ich Maa Meri (x2) Hath Rakh Pehloon Te Turgay Ay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hy Saal Aataran Di Bibi Darbaar Chon Wapas Jad Aayi
Deevaran Phar Phar Turdi Si Keeti Ummat Ay Jay Rasvayi
Ek Pal Bi Chain Nay Aaya Har Wailay Rondi Ray Ay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hadh Hogay Sehn De Rowayn Te Ummat Ne Pehra Laaya Ay
Din Raat Batool Nu Re Re Kay Jina Loghko Aan Sataya Ay
Zainab Di Chadar Karbal Vich Ohna Loghkan Lutt Lay Ay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zahra De Ghaar Nu Do Vaari Ummat Ne Aan Jalaya Ay
Jidi Maa Di Janazay Nu Loghkan Ad Raat De Vailay Chaya Ay
Sirr Nanagay Pedal Dhi Ohdi Vich Shaam De Turdi Ray Ay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek Lohti Dhi Payambar Di Jad Vich Darbar Di Aayi Ay
Na Pakh Mahool De Vich Zahra Bo Rowi Te Kurlayi Ay
Nay Haq Milya Ay Bibi Nu Bari Dair Koloti Ray Ay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kyon Paak Batool Di Azmat Nu Sab Zalim Gay Si Bul Loghko
Tareekh De Saray Raviyoun Ton May Puchda Haan Ek Gal Loghko
Jida Sang Te Puthar Quran Paray Kiwain Maa Muslay Nu Bulgay Ay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Bari Azmat Walan Duniya Te Mazloom Hussain Da Roza Ay
Bekafan Batool De Bachra Da Ay Moijza Hassan Anoka Ay
Karbal De Kafan Di Duniya Nu Har Wailay Hasrat Rehndi Ay.
